one_line: Rashtrakuta king and patron of the great monolithic Kailasa temple at Ellora in 8th‑century Maharashtra.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium-tall, sturdy warrior-king build with broad shoulders and a grounded stance.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyes with thick brows, neatly groomed moustache but clean-shaven chin, default expression calm and composed with a hint of strategic intensity.
appearance.hair: Thick, wavy black hair pulled back into a low, neatly wrapped topknot at the back of the crown, with a few controlled strands framing the temples; a simple golden band (plain kalagi-like circlet) around the head just above the forehead, no towering crown.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate 8th‑century Deccan royal attire: an off‑white, finely woven cotton ankle‑length dhoti wrapped in the Deccan style with neat pleats at the front and a broad border in dull gold; upper body in a fitted, short‑sleeved maroon angarkha-style tunic reaching mid‑thigh, tied at the right side with a subtle overlap; over the left shoulder a soft, mustard‑gold silk uttariya (shawl) draped diagonally across the chest and back, its ends hanging behind; bare forearms but with two slim gold kadas on each wrist and a single armlet on the right bicep with a simple floral motif; neck adorned with two modest gold necklaces—a shorter bead chain and a slightly longer flat-plate chain—rather than heavy jewels; small gold stud earrings; around the waist a broad leather‑backed cloth girdle dyed deep brown, with a central oval bronze buckle engraved with a simple geometric pattern; on his feet, brown leather sandals with a toe loop, practical for rocky terrain; overall textiles are plain or minimally patterned, emphasizing solid colours and subtle borders, befitting a warrior-king rather than a flamboyant court dandy.
appearance.signature: A rolled architectural plan scroll held in his left hand, bound with a simple red cord, and in his right hand a short, straight iron measuring rod with etched gradation marks, symbolizing his patronage and oversight of Kailasa’s rock-cut engineering.

ref_desc: Krishna I appears as a medium-brown, sharp-eyed Deccan warrior-king in his late 30s with wavy black hair in a low topknot and simple gold headband, wearing a maroon angarkha over an off‑white gold-bordered dhoti, mustard-gold shawl, brown belt and sandals, modest gold jewelry, and holding a rolled architectural scroll and a straight iron measuring rod.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Krishna I of the Rashtrakutas: a late-30s medium-tall Deccan warrior-king with an oval face, strong jaw, medium-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes, thick brows, and a neat moustache with clean-shaven chin, expression calm and intensely focused. His thick wavy black hair is pulled into a low, compact topknot at the back of the crown, controlled strands at the temples, encircled by a simple plain golden band above the forehead, not a tall crown. Dress him in strictly 8th‑century Deccan royal clothing: an off‑white ankle-length cotton dhoti with neat front pleats and a dull-gold border, a fitted short-sleeved maroon angarkha-style tunic to mid-thigh tied at the right side, and a mustard-gold silk uttariya draped from the left shoulder diagonally across the chest and back, ends trailing behind. Add modest gold jewelry only: two slim bangles per wrist, a single right armlet, two simple gold necklaces, and small gold stud earrings. Cinch the waist with a deep brown broad cloth-and-leather girdle with an oval bronze buckle etched with a simple pattern, and put brown leather sandals with toe loops on his feet. Place a rolled architectural plan scroll bound with a red cord in his left hand and a short straight iron measuring rod with etched gradation marks in his right, symbolizing his role as patron of the Kailasa rock-cut temple. Use a palette dominated by maroon, mustard gold, off‑white, deep brown, and dull gold, and show him from multiple angles to clearly display face, hair, costume, and props in a consistent heroic but historically grounded design.
